svg.title: Four Prompts, Four Shapes
svg.desc: Four real prompts side by side: an analysis prompt that uses only the attached data and separates observations from explanations, a research prompt that asks for linked sources, a drafting prompt that sets length, tone and next step, and a brainstorming prompt that asks for twenty varied ideas without judging them.
svg.text: Name the task type, then give it what it needs.
Using only the attached applications data, give
the top 3 funding gaps with counts. Keep
What have three national funders published on
youth grants since 2025? Link each source.
Write a 150-word decision letter to an applicant:
warm, plain, one clear next step.
